programme.title: PL MOMENTS - EP7
programme.desc: Live. Over a nine season spell in the Premier League, Jimmy Floyd Hasselbaink etched his name into footballing folklore as one of the most dynamic goalscorers in the competition's history. Fourth all time in Premier League goals for Chelsea, Hasselbaink's iconic freekicks and powerful finishes have seen him score some of the League's most memorable goals. This week, the Dutch international sits down with PL Moments to break down how to strike the ball, and talk us through his ten favourite moments fro.

programme.title: PL REWIND - EP10
programme.desc: Live. Michael Owen burst onto the scene for Liverpool at just seventeen years of age, and in two consecutive seasons the teenage sensation won the Premier League Golden Boot. Owen recalls those campaigns for the Reds, reliving the key moments that helped him develop into one of the greatest players of his generation.

programme.title: REVIEW - MW10 - EP10
programme.desc: Live. An extensive recap of Matchweek 10, showcasing the thrills, spills and major talking points from each Premier League fixture.

programme.title: THE BIG INTERVIEW - EP12

At the center of this community are the Duprees, a powerful and prestigious multi-generational family that is the very definition of Black royalty. programme.title: Live: Get Up
programme.desc: ESPN's morning show features host Mike Greenberg with a rotating and diverse group of analysts opining about and analyzing the latest news from the world of sports. The two-hour, personality-driven show originates from Hudson Square in Lower Manhattan, a modern media hub for ESPN and The Walt Disney Company's New York-based teams. Greenberg, aka "Greeny," is formerly one-half of ESPN Radio's longtime "Mike & Mike" morning show.

programme.title: Live: First Take

programme.title: Live: The Pat McAfee Show
programme.desc: Pat McAfee brings his humor and candor; he and his cast of characters unpack the day's top stories and interview the biggest names in sports.

programme.desc: Peter Schrager's daily show will feature rotating panelists focusing heavily on the NFL while also providing coverage of other major sports stories.

programme.desc: In-depth, comprehensive daily coverage of all aspects of the NBA from expert analysts.

programme.title: NFL Live

programme.title: Live: NBA Basketball

programme.title: Live: Inside the NBA

The show also welcomes various guest analysts throughout the season.
